notes: Ruka 0.4.6: signed updates and rollback. The Ed25519 update key is now pinned, and every release manifest must carry a valid signature. Three unfinished launches set a rollback flag and the app offers the previous release. Settings can download and reinstall the previous version from the signed manifest. A block map is published with the installer; the updater still downloads the full installer. Installer Authenticode signing is still not configured.
